paper.title: On the anisotropic deformation behavior of a low-density medium manganese steel
paper.paper_scope: Investigation of the anisotropic deformation behavior of a low-density medium manganese steel (Fe-7.95Mn-0.25C-4.94Al, wt.%) with a banded microstructure of delta-ferrite and ultrafine gamma+alpha aggregates, comparing tensile loading along the rolling direction (RD) versus the transverse direction (TD) using in-situ synchrotron HEXRD, high-resolution micro-DIC, EBSD and TEM, with focus on strain partitioning and strain-induced martensitic transformation kinetics.

aliases: medium-Mn lightweight steel with Al additions
alloys.description: A low-density medium manganese lightweight steel with Al addition to reduce mass density and promote delta-ferrite formation; selected to study anisotropic deformation of its banded microstructure.
alloys.alloys_notes: Fe is the balance element. Mass density calculated to be ~7.40 g/cm^3; Al addition reduces density by 6.2%. Composition reported in wt.%.

source.reason: Block b0022 explicitly states the studied steel composition as Fe-7.95Mn-0.25C-4.94Al (in wt.%), and blocks b0012/b0014 describe it as a low-density/lightweight medium Mn steel.

processes.process_name: Intercritical annealing 850°C/10 min + water quenching, tensile loaded along rolling direction
processes.description: Tensile specimen of the Fe-7.95Mn-0.25C-4.94Al steel after vacuum induction melting, homogenization at 1100°C, hot rolling to ~3 mm (temperature maintained above ~1000°C), cold rolling to ~1.5 mm, intercritical annealing at 850°C for 10 min and water quenching to room temperature; the tensile loading axis is parallel to the rolling direction (parallel to the banding direction).
processes.processes_notes: Shares identical thermomechanical processing with the TD sample; distinguished only by tensile loading direction relative to the banded microstructure.

source.reason: Block b0022 reports the full processing route (melting, 1100°C homogenization, hot/cold rolling, IA 850°C/10 min, water quenching); block b0027 states that two sample orientations (RD and TD) were tensile tested, and block b0012 specifies loading parallel to the banding direction for RD.

processes.process_name: Intercritical annealing 850°C/10 min + water quenching, tensile loaded along transverse direction
processes.description: Tensile specimen of the Fe-7.95Mn-0.25C-4.94Al steel after vacuum induction melting, homogenization at 1100°C, hot rolling to ~3 mm (temperature maintained above ~1000°C), cold rolling to ~1.5 mm, intercritical annealing at 850°C for 10 min and water quenching to room temperature; the tensile loading axis is parallel to the transverse direction (perpendicular to the banding direction).
processes.processes_notes: Shares identical thermomechanical processing with the RD sample; distinguished only by tensile loading direction relative to the banded microstructure.
